name: Adaeze O.
text: After two months of the night ritual my edges are filling back in. The scent alone calms me down after a long day.

name: Yemisi A.
text: I was losing so much hair after my baby. This oil slowed the shedding within weeks — my shower drain says thank you.

name: Ngozi E.
text: Light, absorbs well, no greasy residue under my wigs. I only wish the 4 oz lasted longer, because my whole family now uses it.

name: Amina S.
text: The 5-minute massage has become my me-time. My scalp feels cooler and the itching is completely gone.

name: Chiamaka N.
text: My hairstylist noticed the new growth before I did. Now she asks what I use at every appointment.

name: Folake B.
text: I have 4C hair and most oils just sit on top. This one sinks in, and my strands feel stronger at the root.

name: Ifeoma K.
text: Bought it for the rosemary, stayed for the calm. My husband has started using it on his beard too.

name: Temitope A.
text: Postpartum shedding had me in tears. Three weeks in, the handfuls of hair stopped. I am already on my second bottle.

name: Zainab U.
text: Smells like a spa. My braids itch less and my scalp no longer flakes, even in harmattan season.

name: Osato E.
text: I do the Sunday ritual with my daughters now. Their hairlines are thriving and it has become our little tradition.
